vocabularies.description: Quality levels for imperfections according to ISO 5817//Bewertungsgruppen für Unregelmäßigkeiten nach ISO 5817
vocabularies.justification: Two vocabularies instead of one: target level (B/C/D) and Annex C rating (C63/B90/B125) are different value domains; one shared list would allow invalid values on each property (e.g. target 'B125', rating 'D') and makes the series table ambiguous. WELDING. namespace because both are generic welding-standard lists (like WELDING.WELD_TYPE) and avoid the live-only codes ISO_5817_CLASS / WELD_ANALYSIS_RATING.

code_scheme.reason: Codes must be unique per space/project; the weld-type letter (B/C) separates the two series of series 1 and avoids the legacy codes S1-n in /FB_72 (resolution Q1).

layout.link_rules: Steps are children of the specimen only (depth 1); inventory objects are parents of steps; no step->step links; no OBJECT properties to inventory.
